subject: City Clerk Audit and Election Review
overview: The Council referred a review of the City Clerk’s office to committee following concerns over voter registration lists and an external audit. Members also honored the resigning Director of Public Works and declined a request to reconsider indoor mask mandates.

items.title: Labor update from Teamsters Local 25
items.summary: Steven South alleged the city hired private investigators to follow department of public works employees and announced the recent organization of school administrators into the union.

items.title: Resolution 21-619: Recognition of the Sloan Family
items.summary: Approved a resolution thanking the Sloan family and Century Bank staff for their philanthropy and community contributions following the bank's acquisition by Eastern Bank.

items.title: Resolution 21-620: Review of City Clerk and Registrar of Voters
items.summary: Referred to the Committee of the Whole a discussion regarding an external review of the City Clerk's office and the status of 12,546 voters who were moved to inactive status prior to the election.

items.title: Resolution 21-621: Recognition of DPW Director Brian Kerins
items.summary: Approved a citation honoring Director of Public Works Brian Kerins for his years of service following his resignation from the city.

items.title: Resolution 21-622: Lung Cancer Awareness Month
items.summary: Approved a resolution recognizing November 2021 as Lung Cancer Awareness Month to promote the importance of early detection and research funding.

items.title: Resolution 21-623: Board of Health Mask Regulations
items.summary: A motion to request that the Board of Health reconsider mask regulations and that the health director attend a council meeting failed to pass.

items.title: Resolution 21-624: Yard Waste Pickup Extension
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to extend the yard waste pickup schedule by two weeks due to late foliage.

items.title: Reports of Committees and Routine Business
items.summary: Approved a committee report on fire station funding and tabled two sets of meeting minutes for further review.
